manifesto.title: Innovation arrives without warning. Is your company ready to adapt?
manifesto.lead: Your company has a unique way of working. We get to know it, talk to your team, and learn how you operate before writing a single line of code.
manifesto.marginalia: Culture is what sets a company apart. Your software should carry yours.
paragraphs: Your software is part of how your company grows. We eliminate manual work for your team and give you real control, from inventory to people, so your business keeps growing even when you're away.

That's why the change starts from the inside: your culture, your processes, your people and the way your company shows up to the world. The result is a company that adapts faster, running on software that feels like it was always part of it.

inside.title: From the inside out
inside.description: We learn your operation before we propose anything. The brief is what you tell us; the answer comes from what we see in your company.

process.title: Process over product
process.description: Your workflow is the spec. We don't reshape your team to fit a tool — we shape the tool around your team.

partnership.title: Long-term partnership
partnership.description: We ship, and we stay — evolving your system as your business grows.

services.title: Everything your company needs, built the way it works.

custom.title: Custom systems
custom.description: ERPs, CRMs, internal tools and full applications designed around the exact way your team works.

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Institutional websites, landing pages, online stores and client portals — fast, bilingual-ready, easy for your team to update and built to turn visitors into conversations.

ai.title: AI integration
ai.description: We put AI to work inside your operation — assistants that answer from your own data, automatic reading of documents and emails, smart triage and copilots inside the tools your team already uses. Practical, secure and measured against real results.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: We map your team's repetitive work — reports, approvals, data entry — and replace it with quiet automations that run while you sleep.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Real-time views of what matters to your business: sales, stock, operations, people. Your decisions stop relying on gut feeling.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect the tools your company already uses — accounting, e-commerce, logistics, payments — into one consistent operation.

differentials.title: Built with you, not just for you.
differentials.subtitle: An engineering team that becomes part of your company — your culture, your rituals, your goals — for as long as you need us.

embedded.title: Embedded with your team
embedded.description: We treat your operation like our own. Daily contact, shared rituals, full transparency on what's being built and why.

diagnostic.title: Diagnosis first, code second

honest.title: Honest delivery
honest.description: Scope, timeline and cost are set in your contract before we start. Daily and weekly updates, working software every sprint. If something slips, you hear it from us first.

lasting.title: Built to last
lasting.description: Clean architecture, documented code and a handover that lets your team keep the system running long after we ship.

faq.subtitle: Still have a question? Book a free call and ask us directly.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: Every project is priced from its scope. Discovery and scope are free: we map your needs and write the scope, timeline and price into a contract proposal before you commit to anything.

items.q: Are discovery and scope really free?
items.a: Yes. We meet your team, document the problem and prepare the scope, timeline and cost at no charge. The materials are handed over once the contract is signed.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. Smaller tools take weeks; larger systems are delivered in phases over months. The timeline is written into your contract, and you see working software every sprint.

items.q: How will I know how the project is going?
items.a: You get daily and weekly updates, and you can follow every phase and milestone live in the Adapto Tracker with a private access code.

items.q: What kind of companies do you work with?
items.a: Small and mid-sized businesses whose processes don't fit off-the-shelf software, from retail and services to logistics and operations.

items.q: Do you only work with companies in Vancouver?
items.a: We're based in Vancouver and work with companies across Canada and the United States.
You get documentation, training and a warranty period. After that, we can keep evolving the system with you, or hand it over to your own team.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body:
Adapto Software House ("Adapto", "we") is a software studio based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. We build software for our clients and run the Adapto Tracker, where clients follow their projects.

The people in charge of protecting personal information at Adapto are Arthur D'Eça Morgenstern Vinhas Marchetti and Eduardo Cambraia Borges, co-founders. You can reach them at contact@adapto-sh.com for any question about this policy or the data we hold.

sections.heading: What this policy covers
sections.body:
This policy covers this website (adapto-sh.com), the Adapto Tracker (tracker.adapto-sh.com) and the way we handle personal information while working with you.

Data that belongs to a client's own product or users, which we may handle while building or maintaining it, is also governed by the agreement we sign with that client.

sections.heading: What we collect
How we use it, and why
The Adapto Tracker
sections.body:
The Tracker shows a client their project timeline through a private access code shared only with them. An email address added to a project receives nothing until it is confirmed from its own inbox, and it can be removed at any time from the project page.

When a meeting is accepted, a Google Calendar event with a Google Meet link is created and the invitation is sent to the meeting's participants. If you choose to message us by WhatsApp or Apple Messages, that conversation happens in those services, under their own privacy policies.

The client's project page uses no analytics or advertising cookies. Our team's sign-in uses a strictly necessary session cookie.

sections.heading: Analytics and cookies
sections.body: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how people find and use this website, and Vercel Speed Insights to measure page performance. Google Analytics sets cookies and only runs after you accept them in the banner. The same applies to the Meta Pixel, which we may use to measure our ads on Instagram and Facebook: it tells Meta that a visit or a booking happened, and Meta processes that under its own policy, but it never receives your name, email or message. If you arrive through a campaign link, your browser also keeps the link's campaign tags and the referring site until you close the tab. No cookie is involved, and these details only reach us if you book a call. Speed Insights collects anonymous performance timings and sets no cookies. You can change your choice at any time from the link in the footer.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
Where your data is stored
sections.body:
The Tracker's database is hosted by Supabase in the United States (North Virginia, us-east-1). Vercel, Resend and Google also process data in the United States and other countries. This means your information may be stored outside Canada, outside Quebec and outside the European Union, where it may be accessible to local authorities under the laws of those countries.

We choose providers that offer strong security and contractual protections for these transfers, such as standard contractual clauses or equivalent safeguards, and we assess them before we use them.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body:
• Contact-form messages and call bookings: as long as the conversation stays relevant to a possible or ongoing project, and no more than 24 months after our last exchange.
• Tracker data (emails, meetings, messages): for the life of the project, then up to 24 months after it ends, unless you ask us to delete it sooner. An email removed from a project is deleted right away.
• Project information you share with us: as set out in our agreement, and otherwise no longer than needed to deliver and support the project.
• Security logs: a few weeks, unless needed to investigate an incident.
• Analytics data: Google's standard 14-month retention.

We keep accounting records as long as the law requires.

sections.heading: How we protect it
sections.body: We protect personal information with measures that match its sensitivity: encrypted connections (HTTPS), access limited to the people who need it, database rules that keep each client's data apart, secret keys kept on our servers only, links in our emails protected by single-purpose random tokens, and limits that block repeated attempts to guess access codes. No system is perfectly secure, but we review and improve these measures regularly.

sections.heading: If something goes wrong
sections.body: If an incident involving your personal information creates a risk of serious harm, we will notify you and the competent authorities as the law requires, and tell you what happened and what we are doing about it.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body:
You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, to stop using it, or to withdraw a consent you gave (for example, analytics or notification emails). You can also ask for a copy of the information you gave us in a commonly used format.

These rights are protected in Canada by PIPEDA and British Columbia's PIPA, in Quebec by Law 25, and in the European Union and the United Kingdom by the GDPR. If you are in the EU or the UK, you may also object to processing based on our legitimate interests.

Write to contact@adapto-sh.com. We will answer within 30 days and may ask you to confirm your identity first.

sections.heading: Complaints
sections.body: If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada, the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia, or, in Quebec, the Commission d'accès à l'information. If you are in the European Union or the United Kingdom, you can contact your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: Our website and services are meant for businesses and are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 14.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy when our services or the law change. The date at the top shows the latest version. If a change is significant, we will tell our clients by email or in the Tracker before it applies.
